subject: prd/impl-review
statement: Before invoking each assurance pass, the already-selected review harness adapter shall resolve the joined semantic demand through its review-role mapping independently of the implementation route, selecting the least-cost qualified native profile satisfying every minimum; exact resolution is preferred, promotion may only strengthen named components, and invalid or unsupported resolution shall stop before that pass's model invocation without switching harnesses.
rationale: review and implementation need different qualified capacity while harness choice remains an upstream credential and egress decision
fit_criterion: exhaustive harness×joined-demand review-role conformance selects the cheapest dominating native profile or a named unsupported terminal; every resolved real-runtime launch matches its recorded harness, role, native profile, and effective effort/context; differing implementation/review mappings launch the review mapping; invalid, weakening, mismatched-launch, and unsupported fixtures cannot produce accepting evidence and retain the selected harness
